The article states the Nigeria Data Protection Commission issued the GAID and applies the NDPA and GAID provisions on automated decisions and AI.

A tech lawyer, Olumide Babalola, says the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 recognises risks of automated decision-making and safeguards against decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

Senate ICT committee chair Shuaib Salisu said the National Digital Economy and E-Governance Bill, now at third reading, provides a regulatory framework for the responsible use of AI systems, categorises AI systems into four or five categories with different deployment requirements, and would apply to AI agents.
